verification_rationale: The evidence states that a SameSite=None cookie must include Secure and that user agents reject it otherwise. This contradicts the claim that such a cookie can be set without Secure and accepted for cross-site use.
claim_text: A cookie configured with SameSite=None can be set without the Secure attribute and still be accepted for cross-site use.
evidence_text: Cookies that specify SameSite=None must also specify Secure. User agents reject cookies with SameSite=None that do not include Secure.
